verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch ships an official MCP server that a runtime probe confirmed completes a full keyless stdio JSON-RPC handshake, and a separate runtime probe verified a real local Elasticsearch instance can index a document and run a BM25 query end-to-end via the REST API, matching official docs on official clients and one-line local setup. This covers the API and MCP paths concretely with hands-on verification; missing for 10: no dedicated first-party 'CLI' tool evidence (only curl/API examples and clients), and no probe showing the MCP server actually performing index/query operations beyond the handshake.
